title: Instrumental Variables in Continuous-Time Stochastic Processes
abstract: arXiv:2611.07674v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal questions often arise in systems that evolve in continuous time. While instrumental variable (IV) methods provide a principled approach to identify causal effects in static or discrete-time settings, even in the presence of unobserved confounding, they do not yet extend to continuous-time dynamics. In this work, we develop an IV framework for stationary continuous-time stochastic processes parameterized by stochastic differential equations (SDE), where the instrument itself takes the form of a stochastic process. We encode the structural sparsity and causal effects directly at the infinitesimal level of the drift, and contrast these assumptions with the IV assumptions on the discretized version of the same process. Based on these structural assumptions, we derive moment restrictions using path-valued instruments. We show how these restrictions simplify for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes and present an identification condition togeth

translated_title: 连续时间随机过程中的工具变量
translated_abstract: 因果问题常常出现在随时间连续演化的系统中。虽然工具变量（IV）方法为在静态或离散时间设置中识别因果效应提供了一种有原则的方法，即使存在未观测的混杂因素也能适用，但这类方法尚未扩展到连续时间动力学。在这项工作中，我们为以随机微分方程（SDE）参数化的平稳连续时间随机过程开发了一个工具变量框架，其中工具变量本身以随机过程的形式出现。我们直接在漂移项的无穷小层面编码结构稀疏性和因果效应，并将这些假设与同一过程离散化版本上的工具变量假设进行对比。基于这些结构假设，我们利用路径值工具变量推导出矩约束条件。我们展示了这些约束条件在Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程下如何简化，并给出了一个识别条件……
tldr: 该论文首次将工具变量方法扩展到由随机微分方程参数化的连续时间随机过程中，通过在漂移项的无穷小层面编码结构稀疏性与因果效应，并利用路径值工具变量的矩约束条件，实现了连续时间动力学系统中因果效应的识别。
en_tdlr: This paper extends instrumental variable methods to stationary continuous-time stochastic processes parameterized by SDEs, enabling causal identification in continuous-time dynamics through structural assumptions encoded at the infinitesimal level of the drift and moment restrictions derived from path-valued instruments.
